response.overview: Five friends set out on an unexpected adventure after one of them discovers a mysterious map left behind by a deceased relative. Believing it could lead them to a hidden treasure, the group follows the map into the unknown. As they search deeper, tensions begin to rise. Arguments and disagreements divide the friends, eventually forcing them to split up and continue the search separately, but the further they follow the map, the stranger things become. What began as an exciting treasure hunt soon turns into a dangerous journey that tests their friendship, courage and trust.
response.tagline: "I found a really dusty box that looked real old so naturally I investigated"
response.title: The Map With No End
